# SEO

Site defaults in `app.brain`:

- **titleTemplate**: `%s · Shop`

| Path | Indexable | Sitemap source | Keyword |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/` | yes | static route | `shop` |
| `/admin/orders` | no | excluded: guarded | — |
| `/products/:id` | yes | paths() export (prerendered) | — |

`brain build` writes robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt from these routes (`brain guide seo`).
